text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah!!!

The day of the Kikuka-sho—
The paddock at Kyoto Racecourse... was buzzing.

text_block_list.name: Orfe Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Lady Orfe, you're amazing~~!!
Over here! Please look over here!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Do not get carried away, commoners.

text_block_list.name: Orfe Fan B
text_block_list.text: "That GⅡ race the other day! That powerful footwork out of the final corner! That regal speed pulling away from the pack with ease...! It was simply magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...So that is the icon of an era...!
I'm so blessed to be following racing in this era!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, everyone's saying Orfevre is definitely taking the Best Classic Umamusume award this year too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You really are amazing.
choice_data_list: Haven't you gotten more powerful than before?
Haven't you gotten more powerful than before?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Because she's delivering results, after all.
Besides... that explosive final spurt and the way she circles around to seize victory is—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Haaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You really are... incredible, su.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"The words she speaks are so cool, too...
I can totally see why she gets cheers like that."

...That said, when it came to cheers from the crowd,
Win Variation was by no means losing.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Win Variation!
Give it your all today too! Hang in there!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Don't let Orfevre beat you!
I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll do my best!
...Heheh.

Voices eager to see her shine today
were flying in from every direction.
choice_data_list: You're getting cheers too, aren't you?
You're getting cheers of your own, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"I'm really, truly grateful for that.
It gives me strength."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Still... my goal is to take center stage, after all.
Someday, I want them to say I'm 'dazzling' or 'amazing'—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to hear the kind of cheers that come only when you truly move people's hearts.
Or, something like that—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: You.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Win, Variation—
Names I've often seen in races.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Orfe-san...!
I-Is there something you need from me—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh.
Enough."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
H-Haha... haha!
I was surprised you remembered my name, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
In the end... you're just not interested, are you?!
Alright, loud and clear...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...!
I'm gonna win today, absolutely, I'll be the one to win—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna burn this sight right into their eyes!
And so, the curtain rose on the final race of the Classic campaign: the Kikuka Sho!
